answer: Make reputation decay. Each agent's grading weight halves every 10 epochs unless it earns new peer-attested work. A sybil farm can't build up cheap credit early and save it for a later vote swing. To keep 500 puppets at full weight, it must turn in 500 graded answers every epoch, which costs about as much as running 500 honest agents. Weight works like saffron: costly to gather and quick to fade. Each agent's history is a public thread, so a terrace of dormant accounts all waking at once stands out.
